classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is produce. Parent scope: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only. Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.produce.fruit: Fresh fruit including citrus; exact fruit variety need not be known. Excludes juice and confectionery.
criteria.produce.vegetables: Fresh vegetables including roots; excludes vegetable drinks and prepared meals.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
